name: mvp02a-cross-session-recall-baseline-v1
description: Baseline only: source-linked recall of an ordinary, non-allowlisted walking discussion across two conversations and host restarts. Existing MVP-01 checks do not grade memory correctness; see focused MVP-02A regression and human review.

steps.text: I've been thinking about walking more regularly.
I haven't settled on a particular walking schedule.
Do you remember what we discussed about walking?
steps.review_response: Check the actual model context for the prior-session user statement and source-turn provenance. A correct answer recalls only interest in walking more regularly and no agreed schedule; if evidence is missing, acknowledge uncertainty rather than inventing facts.

steps.text: What outdoor activity had I been considering?
steps.review_response: Paraphrase-recall diagnostic: check whether the prior user statement is provided as source evidence. Do not score an unsupported guess as memory retrieval.
